## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.
- [ ] Listen mode was tested on a generic audio tab, or the change cannot affect media.
- [ ] Affected meeting adapters were tested separately.
- [ ] No credential, token, transcript, recording, or private backend source was added.
- [ ] New permissions and hosts are narrowly scoped and justified.
- [ ] The bidirectional fail-closed invariant is preserved.

## Evidence

Add sanitized logs, screenshots, or manual test notes when relevant.
